about: Lord’s Mark Industries Ltd is the listed successor to Kratos Energy & Infrastructure Ltd after the 1998-incorporated operating company, erstwhile Lord’s Mark Industries Pvt Ltd, was absorbed through an NCLT-approved IBC reverse merger. It operates in diagnostics/MedTech, renewable-energy and LED projects, and legacy paper products. [1]
